title: DreameHome device sharing and MQTT broker before 2026-10-26 contained an incorrect authorization vulnerability that…
description: DreameHome devices and their MQTT broker versions before 2026-10-26 have an incorrect authorization vulnerability. This flaw allows former share recipients to continue receiving MQTT status messages from a device even after the owner has revoked sharing access. While application access and device-command API calls are properly revoked, the MQTT broker still accepts subscriptions to the device's status topic using identifiers exposed during sharing. This enables unauthorized monitoring of home map data and device status.
